en: Sam is smiling and laughing. Sam feels …
Smiling and laughing show that Sam is happy.
Crying often means someone is sad.

Stamping and frowning show Tom is cross.

Yawning and closing eyes mean Ada is sleepy.
Ben hears a loud bang in the dark and hides. Ben feels …
Hiding after a loud bang in the dark shows Ben is scared.
It is Lily’s birthday tomorrow. She cannot wait! She feels …
Not being able to wait means Lily is excited.
Joe gets a gold star. He feels …
Getting a gold star makes Joe feel proud.
Zara’s friend is away and she has no one to play with. She feels …
Having no one to play with can make you feel lonely.

An open mouth and wide eyes show surprise.

Asking “Are you OK?” shows you care.

We smile when we are happy.
What helps when you feel cross?
Taking deep breaths helps you calm down.

example.why_en: Smiling and laughing show that Sam is happy.

en.title: How do they feel?
en.teach: Faces show feelings. A smile means happy, tears mean sad, a frown can mean cross.
